# MIND Detective 0.3.1

Patch release contract for the external-review remediation cycle. Publication remains gated on explicit human authorization and exact post-merge `main` CI.

## Safety and product truth

- enforces high-risk action-uncertainty routing at interaction ingress;
- replaces free-prose Search echo with an explicit deterministic checklist-target input;
- makes `Проверил — не нашёл` / `Checked — not found` match the stored `not_found` result;
- fixes checked/inaccessible progress precedence;
- makes the Web/PWA reconstruction boundary explicit: Web is a physical Search/checklist surface, while full reconstruction remains plugin/agent capability.

## Evaluation and architecture

- validates active contract helpers for production reachability and removes obsolete dead helpers;
- reconciles live evaluation events with the actual decision metrics;
- makes Case import local and removes the Web validation network dependency;
- records semantic scenario execution as explicit manual governance rather than claiming an automated model runner;
- types and renders proposal `copy_key` values through RU/EN copy;
- adds installable 192/512 PNG and Apple touch PWA icons.

## Portability and documentation

- resolves the API plugin root through `MIND_DETECTIVE_PLUGIN_ROOT` or bounded discovery instead of fixed monorepo parent depth;
- updates RU/EN startup documentation and version surfaces;
- records external verification metadata for the four scientific DOI references reviewed on 2026-09-12.

No Case v3, Bayesian/POD state, calibrated location percentages, cloud sync, or new production skill is introduced.
